name: Kurama Genjuurou
source:
The protagonist's grandfather.
He's as strict on Masaomi as he is on himself. Though he owns a Japanese-style inn, he is, for the most part, retired.

[From [url=http://senren.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]NekoNyan[/url]]
